bounds.domain: One immutable release input: staging or production; blank, partial, complete test or complete live catalog; provider validation success/failure; zero to two optional bindings; one atomic Worker submission.
bounds.conformance: Existing preparation tests execute the real shell, queue and secret-file boundary with external CLIs isolated. The catalog tests execute real provider-object validation through read-only fixture responses.
bounds.gaps: The model assumes immutable workflow inputs and an atomic named-binding Worker update. Cloudflare transport and secret persistence, real Stripe objects, webhook delivery and subscription entitlement require live qualification. Unknown submit outcomes do not imply rollback; read-only observation resolves the modeled outcome. No production billing change is admitted.

assumptions: Weak fairness of preparation, provider submission and read-only outcome observation. Cancellation is permitted only before submission; provider success is not assumed.
